The main takeaway from our work is that

a new class of tetradentate ligands featuring a phenylene core and a combination of thio-imine and diphenolate donor groups can be prepared and that the complexes can be used for the stereoselective catalysis of lactide polymerization.
the {ONSO} zirconium complexes can polymerize rac-lactide in solution, and that the stereoselectivity of the polymerization can be controlled by varying the substituents on the ligand.
